job.title: Casual Certificate 3 and Diploma educators - Echuca
job.description:
Why Join Expect A Star?
 
At Expect A Star, we have spent over 20 years connecting passionate educators with the best childcare centres across Australia. We know that flexibility, great pay, and a supportive team matter. Whether you are looking to balance work with study, family, or just want to experience different teaching philosophies, we put you in the driver’s seat of your career.
 
The Perks & Benefits
  • You are in control: Easily manage your availability and accept shifts directly through our intuitive, user-friendly app.
  • Great pay rates: Earn competitive, above-award casual hourly rates, paid reliably every single week.
  • Block bookings available: Looking for more routine? Lock in stable, consistent block bookings while still enjoying casual rates.
  • Exclusive employee rewards: Access our national perks program, including discounts on gym memberships, health services, retail outlets, travel, and dining.
  • Foot in the door: Expand your experience across different local centres—many of our casual roles lead to permanent placements! 
Your Day-to-Day
As a Casual Educator, no two days are the same, but every day is rewarding. You will:
  • Provide high-quality care and education for children aged 0–5 in nurturing, play-based environments.
  • Support and facilitate meaningful learning experiences and educational programs.
  • Act as a lifesaver for local centres by covering staff absences, lunch breaks, and seasonal leave.
  • Collaborate with permanent centre teams to maintain a safe, welcoming, and inclusive atmosphere.
  • Help monitor and document children’s daily progress and developmental milestones.
What You Need to Bring
We are looking for reliable, enthusiastic educators who love working with children. To be successful, you will need:
  • Qualifications: A Certificate III or Diploma in Early Childhood Education and Care (or be actively studying an ACECQA-approved qualification).
  • Working Rights: Current working rights in Australia.
  • Compliance: A valid paid WWCC
  • Certifications: Geccko Child safety certificate, VIC Mandatory Reporting Certificate and Food Handling certificates (or willingness to obtain).
  • Availability: A minimum of 2 days of availability per week, with flexibility for short-notice morning shifts.
  • Attitude: A warm, adaptable, and proactive nature with excellent communication skills.
About Us
Founded in 2004, Expect A Star is a specialist recruitment agency in the Early Childhood Sector and a proud partner of PeopleIN, the largest talent solutions company in Australia and New Zealand. We are deeply committed to supporting your personal and professional growth, helping you become the best educator you can be.
